info.title: Table for One API
info.description: Implemented application endpoints. Import workers, AI chat, sharing links and Undo execution remain separate. PostgreSQL RLS uses the caller token. Revisioned resource writes require an Idempotency-Key; account deletion uses verified identity and explicit confirmation. A saved plan may have groceryState=needs_review; never shop from its prior grocery projection.
